Turistautak options
Hungary only. This is a fully Hungarian-made map from Turistautak.hu — not an OSM country download, and it does not cover other countries.
These switches apply when the Turistautak map is on Map. They do not change Google Maps or a downloaded OSM region.
Trail blazes — on. Coloured Hungarian waymarks (blue/red/yellow/green). Turn off if the map is too busy in town.
Emphasize paths — on. Magenta highlight on footpaths and tracks, the same colour as OSM Highlight cycleways.
Contour lines — on. Major elevation lines for terrain shape.
Minor contours — off. Extra intermediate lines; useful on a ridge, noisy in a city.
Hiking POI — on. Peaks, springs, alpine huts, shelters, caves, viewpoints.
Protected areas — off. National-park fills and labels.
Urban POI — off. Shops, food, parking, bus stops. Turn on in a village.
Terrain relief — off until HGT elevation files sit next to the map or in hills/. Same DEM files as OSM hillshading.
